title: Chapter 274 Controlling The Toxic Ray Scorpion
content:
Chapter 274 Controlling The Toxic Ray Scorpion

The body tissue of the scorpion was quickly delivered to the Zerg base camp through the space transmission channel and the relay of the transport host.

The Queen of the Zerg built a new Zerg building to study the genes of the scorpion.

With the current technological capabilities of the Zerg, the research soon produced results.

"This kind of scorpion is not a truly intelligent creature. Their population is a bit like a bee colony. These scorpions are the tools of the population. The entire population should be controlled by the Scorpion King behind the scenes!"

"This is somewhat similar to us!"

"We have now cracked their genes and understood their population control methods. We only need to update the gene library of the Zerg host once, and the Zerg host can seize the priority control of the scorpion from the Scorpion King!"

The Queen of the Zerg briefly told Wu Qing about the research results.

"Looking like a scorpion, the race is actually like a bee colony. Sure enough, the evolutionary direction of the insects is similar!"

"Then update the gene library of the Zerg host immediately. The Zerg host can control those scorpions, which is very helpful for the Zerg to intervene in the desert battlefield in advance!"

Wu Qing was not surprised by this research result. As long as it is an insect, the Zerg has a lot of ways to control it.

The desert battlefield opened up by the Naga tribe was very smooth in the early stage of the defense of the desert main city with the intervention of the Zerg destroyers. Coupled with the Naga tribe's own defense power, the Zerg did not have more opportunities to intervene for the time being.

If the Zerg can control a powerful combat unit of the desert population, the Zerg's initiative in the desert battlefield will be much stronger.

Relying on Zerg destroyers alone, the Zerg can only be a fire output tool for the Naga tribe.

Of course, the Zerg is also quite happy to be this fire output tool.

The Queen of Zerg has updated the gene library of the Zerg host unit online. The Zerg host's insect control ability has a strong control ability for the scorpion, a specific creature that has cracked the gene.

After studying the organization and control form of the scorpion population, the Zerg can easily grasp the control ability of the Scorpion King.

The Zerg host ability has been updated. The Zerg hosts distributed above the Naga desert main city immediately used their insect control ability to quickly control all the scorpions lurking underground outside the main city.

In order to better control more scorpions outside the city, Wu Qing took the initiative to consume system resources and upgraded all the Zerg hosts in the Naga desert main city to five stars.

"Elder, after our research, our tribe has a certain control over the scorpions of the same Zerg. We will control those scorpions lurking underground. Please do not attack them actively, noble army!"

Wu Qing explained the situation to Naga through host No. 3.

Naga was very surprised: "You can actually control them?"

"I asked someone to check the information. That kind of scorpion is a highly poisonous ray scorpion. It is a very powerful creature with strong melee and long-range combat capabilities!"

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present, Yeguo Reading, install the latest version.

"Poisonous ray scorpions are very rare. I didn't expect them to appear here and become a member of the evil god camp!"

"My tribe is also studying countermeasures. I didn't expect you to find a way to control them so quickly!"

"I will immediately have someone bring you all the information on poisonous ray scorpions that my tribe has collected. I hope you can better control this terrible enemy!"

After the Naga army was attacked by scorpions and suffered losses, they immediately looked for relevant information about scorpions. This search really made the Naga tribe worried.

This race called poisonous ray scorpions has not appeared many times in records, and each time it appears, it has shown strong combat power.

The poisonous rays they launch with their scorpion tails have very strong long-range lethality and are difficult to remove. Even if those who are hit do not die, they basically lose all combat power.

It is precisely because of this ability that they are named poisonous ray scorpions.

Poisonous ray scorpions are not traditional long-range attack arms. They are equally powerful in close combat and prefer close combat.

In close combat, they will flexibly use the poisonous ray attacks of the scorpion tails, making it difficult to defend against.

With their underground stealth and lurking abilities, they are very suitable for ambushes and sneak attacks. It can be said that this is a very difficult and terrible race to deal with.

Facing this powerful enemy that they have never encountered before, the Naga tribe can only use magic troops to deal with it, or use ordinary troops to fight consumption. They need to summarize a set of coping methods in long-term actual combat.

Now the Zerg has brought news that they can directly control the poisonous ray scorpions, and even use them for their own use to enhance their own combat power. This is really a great news for the Naga tribe!

"Let's go! Let's verify it ourselves! This is very important!"

Naga acted decisively and took host No. 3 to the front line of the desert main city wall.

Outside the wall of the desert main city, there is an area with clear vision, which is shrouded by magic energy, dispelling the wind and sand and the night.

In the distance, there is a sky full of yellow sand, covering everything.

"No. 3, control a few poisonous ray scorpions over!"

"Don't attack! There is no need to be nervous!"

Naga stood on the wall and said to host No. 3.

And ordered the soldiers stationed on the city wall not to attack the poisonous ray scorpions that were about to appear.

The Zerg host controlled ten poisonous ray scorpions to drill out of the ground in the yellow sand, quickly rushed into the area with good vision outside the main city of the Naga Desert, and then stopped.

The Naga army, which had seen the power of the poisonous ray scorpion, immediately went on alert to prevent any accidents.

Wu Qing waited until the Naga army had eliminated their tension before letting the ten poisonous ray scorpions slowly crawl over.

Naga did not feel hostility from the ten poisonous ray scorpions, so she was completely relieved.

"Not bad! I believe in your control ability!"

"But these poisonous ray scorpions cannot enter the city for the time being, so as to avoid unexpected situations that affect the overall situation of the desert battlefield!"

"How do you plan to use these poisonous ray scorpions?"

Naga recognized the control ability of the Zerg, but she could not take risks with the Naga desert main city, and would not let the poisonous ray scorpions controlled by the Zerg enter the main city.

Wu Qing could understand this point. The evil gods in this world are mysterious and unpredictable. If an accident occurs, the Naga tribe may lose all their previous efforts.

Therefore, the Naga tribe will not take this risk.

"Let them stay underground for the time being, and they can fight back when necessary!"

Wu Qing responded through host No. 3.

The poisonous ray scorpion participated in the siege so quickly, indicating that this ancient desert territory is the living area of the poisonous ray scorpion. As long as they exist in large numbers, the Zerg can obtain a large number of troops in this area for free.

With troops, there are many things that can be done in this newly opened desert battlefield.

Now the Zerg is mainly to help the Naga tribe gain a foothold here. If the Naga tribe fails to open up the battlefield, the Zerg can't find a place to come, and everything will be in vain.

The Zerg helped to solve a big enemy, and Naga went back to report the situation to the Naga tribe's high-level officials.

The poisonous ray scorpion controlled by the Zerg was silent, and the scorpion king behind them did not notice the abnormality and continued to send more poisonous ray scorpions.

The five-star Zerg host accepted all the poisonous ray scorpions that came from underground.

Next, until dawn, those desert races did not launch any more attacks.

The desert races around the Naga desert main city are gathering more and more, and it won't take much, and here will usher in a large-scale city attack and defense battle.

During the waiting period, Wu Qing sensed a lot of very powerful auras through the Zerg host. There was a brief confrontation around, and then it returned to calm.

Wu Qing knew that this was a strong man of the Naga tribe. In the confrontation with the strong men in the desert area, it was obvious that the strong men of the Naga tribe were enough to protect the safety of the desert main city, and the desert main city of the Naga tribe was not affected.

Wu Qing judged from the various information collected that the seven-star, eight-star, and nine-star strong men in this world, in fact, were the same as the world he originally lived in, and their strength had not changed qualitatively.

In essence, it was still the quantitative change of the energy that could be controlled, and the improvement in the quality of energy was very small.

This made it possible for low-star strength arms to defeat high-star strength arms. As long as the ordinary army had enough troops, it could also surround and kill powerful enemies.

Wu Qing even saw from the information that there were ordinary armies that specialized in hunting strong men.

So those dark strong men of various races were not omnipotent, they were more of a deterrent force.

Wu Qing guessed that when the strength of this world was upgraded from six stars to seven stars, there would be a slight qualitative change in strength, thus widening the gap between the two star levels.

The so-called strong people among the various races in this world should be strong people with seven stars and above.

The soldiers with seven stars and above are considered the foundation of the various major races in both camps. All parties have a tacit understanding and will not easily send them to participate in the war.

Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects speculated through some obscure information that the soldiers with seven stars and above could participate in the war at will, but such a war could easily consume the foundation of a major race, causing them to quickly lose their status as a major race.

Ordinary races participating in such a war would easily be wiped out by powerful enemies.

It should be that after a lot of painful lessons, all parties have a tacit understanding and no longer easily let the soldiers with seven stars and above participate in the war.

This is actually very easy to understand. It's like two people fighting. If they don't know how to save some strength and start using knives and guns, it's either you or me. This will only result in both sides being hurt and letting others take advantage.

Nowadays, when fighting, neither of them will use weapons easily. They just punch and kick, and even wear boxing gloves. The win or loss of a fight will not make the two people worry about their lives.

If others want to take advantage, the two people will take out knives and guns and fight desperately, which can still deter others.

The truth is such a simple truth.

After the Naga tribe and the strong men of the desert race clashed, they should have tacitly agreed to the fight between their respective armies. Unless it was a matter of life and death, the strong men of both sides would not take action at will.
